findings: VitaShadeSelector lacked live keyboard search input and on-the-fly Cyrillic homoglyph normalizer (Russian 'А', 'В', 'С', 'Д', 'ОМ1' -> '0M1')
VitaShadeSelector lacked 3-zone stratification (cervical, body, incisal) and IPS Natural Die stump shades (ND1-ND9) for orthopedic smile design
Patient card (PatientWorkspaceView & PatientWorkspaceModals) was an architectural orphan: clinical photo protocol and orthodontic photo protocol were completely missing from the patient workspace
Zero disabled buttons (Mandate 8e) and zero cartoon emojis (Mandate 8d pt 7) successfully verified across all photography modules

defects_catalog.description: Orphaned photo protocol in patient workspace: PatientWorkspaceView had no trigger for ClinicalPhotoProtocolModal or OrthodonticPhotoProtocolModal
defects_catalog.resolution: Wired lazy modals into PatientWorkspaceModals and added direct action triggers in PatientWorkspaceView dropdown menu and scans tab

defects_catalog.description: Missing search input in VitaShadeSelector: searchQuery state was declared but not rendered in UI; doctors could not type shade codes
defects_catalog.resolution: Implemented search bar with live auto-normalization of Cyrillic keyboard characters and Bleach aliases

defects_catalog.description: Absence of 3-zone stratification and stump shade selection in VitaShadeSelector
defects_catalog.resolution: Added Stratification Mode tab with 1-click clinical presets (natural, monochrome, youth translucent) and ND1-ND9 stump shade selector
